items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Stanley Dance convinced her to come back in 1972 or 1973 to play the Newport Jazz Festival with Count Basie

ctx.x: Stanley Dance convinced her to come back in 1972 or 1973 to play the Newport Jazz Festival with Count Basie, and her career came full cycle, all the way back. In many ways, she became bigger than she ever was because she was such a great artist.
